subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this stale macOS onboarding branch be closed as superseded by current-main work, or should the author rebase and narrow it to any remaining gap?
rationale: The PR has a protected label and overlaps merged maintainer-owned onboarding work, while the current head still carries security, auth, compatibility, and proof blockers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 as the accepted direction and invite a new narrow follow-up for any remaining gap.

options.title: Request a rebased narrow PR
options.body: Keep this open only if the author rebases onto current main and removes the superseded onboarding/Gateway setup pieces.

options.title: Adopt and repair the branch
options.body: A maintainer can choose to own the compatibility and security risk, but this requires manual review and real macOS proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 as the accepted direction and invite a new narrow follow-up for any remaining gap.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the current-main PRs that now define the macOS onboarding direction.
